integrity: A symbolic proof with standalone integer Smith normal form and finite path-enumeration checks; finite tests are supporting evidence and do not establish the all-parameter theorem. No independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the anti-invariant *chain* complex for a single negatively wound coordinate of bidirected cycle Cartesian products, with each factor length at least five; not general signings or Borel-equivariant path homology. Integral product naturality and cycle path contraction are used in the proof; published priority outside indexed literature remains uncertain.
title: An integral two-torsion staircase in signed toroidal path homology
